Note: All knob-derived parameters in online operations use the midpoint‑biased
knobs F̃ and S̃ defined in Section 1. This does not change the schema, but it
does affect the interpretation of threshold- and gate-related fields.
Note: Consolidation is shallow and embedding-only. It creates ASSOCIATION
centroids without blobs and does not call a summarization, extraction, or
provider backend.
Note: This diagram emphasizes the core memory/signal/association schema. Later
migrations also add memory eviction and reconstruction tables, meta-learning
coefficients, and soft-anchor state/link tables.
Note: Consolidation is external-only; callers invoke C++ `Consolidate()`, C ABI
`cortext_consolidate`, or process a maintenance signal with
`force_consolidation`, rather than scheduling it automatically.
Note: Shallow consolidation may attach existing LABEL nodes by embedding
similarity, but the engine no longer seeds a static label bank or refines labels
with an internal LLM.
Note: Interrupt gating uses a sensitivity-relaxed retrieval threshold
retrieval_thresh_interrupt(F,S) = retrieval_thresh(F) × (1 − 0.12S).
Note: Non-boundary MU gating is relaxed by Sensitivity:
boundary_mult_eff = boundary_mult × (1 − 0.20S).
Note: Allowed interrupts outside flush/spike events mark a pending abort; the
next signal drops the partial unit only if it aligns more with the selected
memory than with the current accumulator centroid. This is operational only
and does not alter the schema.
Note: Retrieval ranking adds an emotion bonus using memories.emotional_intensity
and memories.s_arousal_avg, scaled by an affect_drive computed from current
arousal/emotion/salience.
Note: Strength-based eviction only applies to LONG_TERM memories; ASSOCIATION
and LABEL nodes are retained unless explicitly pruned.
Note: Retrieval seeding scans LONG_TERM and ASSOCIATION embeddings, then graph
expansion follows retained association edges to surface connected nodes.

```{mermaid}
erDiagram
    direction TB

    %% =======================================================================
    %% CORE HIERARCHY: EPISODES → MEMORIES → SIGNALS → (EMBEDDINGS, BLOBS)
    %% =======================================================================

    %% INDEX NOTATION
    %% IDX = simple index | IDX with X = composite index | IDX partial Y = partial index with WHERE Y | IDX DESC = descending index
    %% TABLE INDEXES
    %% EPISODES: end_ts (partial NULL)
    %% MEMORIES: episode_id + start_ts, kind, end_ts (partial WORKING), strength + last_access, cluster_id (partial NOT NULL)
    %% SIGNALS: memory_id + serial_position, source_id (partial NULL memory_id), timestamp (DESC)
    %% ASSOCIATIONS: source_memory_id + edge_type, target_memory_id + edge_type
    %% ACCUMULATORS: episode_id
    %% EMBEDDINGS/BLOBS: virtual tables with internal indexing (sqlite-vec / sqlite-objstore)

    EPISODES ||--o{ MEMORIES : "contains"
    MEMORIES ||--o{ SIGNALS : "contains"
    SIGNALS ||--|| EMBEDDINGS : "has"
    SIGNALS ||--|| BLOBS : "stores"

    %% Episodes: Temporal/semantic context boundaries (Section 3.1.3)
    EPISODES {
        int episode_id PK
        int start_ts "timestamp (ms)"
        int end_ts "timestamp (ms), IDX partial NULL"
        text boundary_type "drift|explicit|inactivity|capacity"
        blob centroid "256d aggregate vector"
        int created_at "timestamp (ms)"
    }

    %% Memories / Graph nodes: grouped signals with decay metrics (LABEL nodes live here)
    MEMORIES ||--|| EMBEDDINGS : "has"
    MEMORIES ||--o| BLOBS : "stores"

    MEMORIES {
        int memory_id PK
        int episode_id FK "IDX with start_ts"
        int embedding_id FK "aggregate embedding (centroid)"
        blob blob_id FK "optional summary content"
        text source_id "opaque source stream id"
        text kind "WORKING|LONG_TERM|ASSOCIATION|LABEL, IDX"
        text label "human readable name (for LABEL kind)"
        int start_ts "timestamp (ms)"
        int end_ts "timestamp (ms), IDX partial WORKING"
        int n_signals "count of signals"
        text modality "text|audio|image"
        real s_max "max signal score (or label salience for LABEL kind)"
        real s_avg "average signal score"
        real s_emotion_max "max emotion_intensity_t during formation"
        real s_arousal_avg "mean arousal_t during formation"
        real boundary_score "Section 3.1.3 change-point probability"
        blob emotion "6d vector - Section 2.2.2"
        blob ambient_mood "6d vector - Section 2.2.4"
        real strength "Section 5.1, IDX with last_access"
        real trace_fast "Section 5.1.1 multi-timescale trace"
        real trace_med "Section 5.1.1 multi-timescale trace"
        real trace_slow "Section 5.1.1 multi-timescale trace"
        real trace_ultra "Section 5.1.1 multi-timescale trace"
        real use_frequency "Section 5.1 EWMA"
        real stability "Section 5.3.3"
        real connectivity "Section 7.2 graph metric"
        real drift_mag "Section 3.1.3"
        real influence "Section 5.4 composite"
        real sustained_influence "Section 5.4 EWMA"
        real contextual_gain "Section 5.2"
        real redundancy "Section 7.2"
        real pre_activation "Section 6.5"
        real lability_state "Section 6.3"
        int suppression_count "Section 6.4 RIF"
        int cluster_id FK "Section 7.3, IDX partial NOT NULL"
        int last_access "timestamp (ms)"
        int created_at "timestamp (ms)"
        blob context "Section 3.1.4 temporal context"
        int retrieved_count "Section 5.2"
        int used_count "Section 5.2"
        real influence_factor "Section 5.2"
        real mean_influence "Section 5.4"
        int last_used "timestamp (ms)"
        blob original_centroid "Section 6.3 reconsolidation"

        int recovery_time_start "Section 6.4 (ms)"
        real suppression "Section 8.4 - competing memory inhibition"
        int suppression_ts "timestamp (ms)"
        text source_origin "Section 8.8 provenance"
        real source_reliability "Section 8.8 reliability prior"
        int source_contradiction_count "Section 8.8"
        int source_last_verified_ts "Section 8.8 (ms)"
        int flashbulb "Section 8.7 - boolean"
        real emotional_intensity "Section 8.7"
        real half_life_bonus "Section 8.7"

        real cascade_decay "Section 8.7"
        real tag_strength "Section 8.7.1 synaptic tagging"
        int tag_expires_at "Section 8.7.1 (ms)"
    }

    %% Signals: Discrete inputs with per-signal metrics
    SIGNALS {
        int signal_id PK
        int memory_id FK "NULL until flush, IDX with serial_position"
        text source_id FK "accumulator, IDX partial NULL memory_id"
        int embedding_id FK
        blob blob_id FK "content hash"
        int timestamp "signal arrival (ms), IDX DESC"
        text modality "text|audio|image"
        text mime
        int serial_position "order within memory"
        real score "composite score"
        real relevance "Section 3.1"
        real mismatch "Section 3.2"
        real surprise "Section 3.2"
        real rarity "Section 3.2"
        real drift "Section 3.1.3"
        real contradiction "Section 3.2"
        real utility "Section 3.3"
        real periphery "Section 3.3"
        real coverage "Section 3.3"
        real salience "Section 2.2"
        real valence "Section 2.2.2"
        real arousal "Section 2.2.2"
        real threshold_t "Section 4.2"
        int write_decision "0|1"
        real coherence "Section 3.1.1"
        real focus_spread "Section 3.1.2"
        real f_effective "Section 3.1.1"
        int created_at "timestamp (ms)"
    }

    %% Embeddings: Vector representations (sqlite-vec virtual table)
    EMBEDDINGS {
        int embedding_id PK "rowid"
        blob embedding "float[256] - sqlite-vec"
        int created_at "timestamp (ms)"
    }

    %% Blobs: Raw content storage (sqlite-objstore virtual table)
    BLOBS {
        blob blob_id PK "SHA256 content hash"
        blob data "raw content: text, audio PCM, image bytes"
    }

    %% =======================================================================
    %% VIEWS (computed, not persisted)
    %% =======================================================================

    SIGNALS ||--o{ RECENT_CONTEXT : "view"
    EMBEDDINGS ||--o{ RECENT_CONTEXT : "view"
    SIGNALS ||--o{ RECENT_SCORES : "view"
    SIGNALS ||--o{ RECENT_IDS : "view"
    EMBEDDINGS ||--o{ RECENT_IDS : "view"
    MEMORIES ||--o{ RECENT_RETRIEVALS : "view"

    RECENT_CONTEXT {
        int signal_id FK "from SIGNALS"
        int embedding_id FK "from EMBEDDINGS"
        blob embedding "from EMBEDDINGS"
        int timestamp "signal time (ms)"
    }

    RECENT_SCORES {
        int signal_id FK "from SIGNALS"
        real score "recent composite scores"
        int timestamp "signal time (ms)"
    }

    RECENT_IDS {
        int embedding_id FK "from EMBEDDINGS"
        int timestamp "recency/LRU tracking"
    }

    RECENT_RETRIEVALS {
        int memory_id FK "from MEMORIES"
        int last_retrieval_ts "implicit feedback cache"
    }

    %% =======================================================================
    %% ASSOCIATIONS - Graph edges between memory/label nodes
    %% =======================================================================

    MEMORIES ||--o{ ASSOCIATIONS : "connects"

    %% Associations: Relationships between graph nodes (memories/labels)
    ASSOCIATIONS {
        int source_memory_id PK,FK "IDX with edge_type"
        int target_memory_id PK,FK "IDX with edge_type"
        text edge_type PK "derived_from|similar_to|co_occurs|implies|contradicts|reinforces|causes|has_label"
        real weight "normalized [0,1] association weight (for cosine-based edges: clamp((cos+1)/2,0,1))"
        real decay_rate
        int last_reinforced "timestamp (ms)"
    }

    %% =======================================================================
    %% ACCUMULATORS (Section 4.4) - Pending memories being built
    %% =======================================================================

    EPISODES ||--o{ ACCUMULATORS : "building"
    ACCUMULATORS ||--o{ SIGNALS : "produces"
    ACCUMULATORS {
        text source_id PK "per-signal accumulator"
        int episode_id FK "current episode, IDX"
        blob mu_acc "256d running mean"
        real drift_acc "WITHIN-UNIT drift accumulator (resets on reset_accumulator). Accumulates normalized context-centroid drift: drift_acc += drift_mag_t/2"
        real s_sum "score sum"
        real s_max "max score"
        int n "count of signals in current unit"
        blob e_peak "256d peak embedding"
        real emo_max "max emotion_intensity_t within current unit"
        real arousal_sum "sum of arousal_t within current unit"
        blob acc_signals_window "ring buffer of recent embeddings for coherence (<= win_coh(T))"
        real drift_accum "PER-STREAM cumulative drift used only for interrupt refractory; does NOT reset on unit boundaries. Updated each step: drift_accum += cosine_dist(x_t, x_{t-1})"
        real drift_at_last_interrupt "PER-STREAM snapshot of drift_accum taken on interrupt; refractory drift since last interrupt is Δ = drift_accum - drift_at_last_interrupt"
        real drift_acc_pacing "streaming pacing accumulator (per stream)"
        blob x_last_check "embedding at last trigger_check (per stream; 256d)"
        blob prev_x "previous signal embedding for this stream (per stream; 256d) used when referencing x_{t−1}"
        blob c_t "temporal context state (Section 3.1.4)"
        int t_start "memory start timestamp (ms)"
        int last_write_ts "for write refractory (ms)"
        int last_signal_ts "for gap detection (ms)"
        real eta_acc "drift EWMA"
        real coherence_prev "previous coherence"
    }

    %% =======================================================================

    %% =======================================================================

    STATE {
```
